formal_specifications.name: Quadratic Map Recurrence
formal_specifications.description: The complex sequence generated by iterating the quadratic polynomial f_c(z) = z^2 + c starting at the critical point z_0 = 0.
formal_specifications.grounding_evidence: Mandelbrot (1982), Chapter 3; standard complex dynamics definition of the parameter slice for quadratic polynomials.

formal_specifications.name: Escape Radius Criterion
formal_specifications.description: If the sequence modulus exceeds 2 at any iteration n, the orbit is guaranteed to escape to infinity, establishing that c is outside the Mandelbrot set.
formal_specifications.grounding_evidence: Douady and Hubbard (1984), Étude dynamique des polynômes complexes, verifying escape radius R=2 for monic quadratic polynomials.

variables.description: The state of the orbit at discrete iteration index n.
The complex parameter coordinate tested for set membership.
Upper bound cutoff on iteration count before classifying orbit as bounded.

invariants: origin_bounded: c = 0 is in set for all max_iter
